description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named OrderActionsControler that manages administrative order actions such as capture, refund, print invoice, list transactions, send invoice, update status, and send download email within the admin panel of a sales-oriented system.

classes.name: OrderActionsControler
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller providing administrative endpoints to manage order operations like capture, refund, invoice printing, transaction listing, email notifications, and status updates.

methods.name: captureOrder
methods.description: Handles capturing payment for an order based on provided order ID, validating permissions and order state.

methods.name: refundOrder
methods.description: Processes a refund for a specific order, validating the refund amount and associating it with the order and customer.

methods.name: printInvoice
methods.description: Generates and streams a PDF invoice for the specified order to the client.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions associated with a specific order, returning detailed transaction data.

methods.name: sendInvoice
methods.description: Sends an invoice email to the customer for a specific order.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an order and sends notification to the customer.

methods.name: sendDownloadEmail
methods.description: Sends an email with download links or files related to the order.
